title: Dataset订单数据工作场景
description: 固定真实源码和合成SQLite上的输入契约、列校验、事务、业务键与查询八项独立只读任务。

scenarios.title: 订单输入与列规则
scenarios.goal: 明确可重用输入、扩列和实际零行取证

tasks.goal: 解释异构订单字典的列并集和缺失值
tasks.prompt: Trace the supplied heterogeneous dictionary-list import and ordered rows. Explain column creation, padding of missing values and whether caller dictionaries are mutated. Use actual pinned APIs and do not edit files.

tasks.goal: 区分关闭自动扩列和拒绝未知字段
tasks.prompt: Does ensure=False satisfy the supplied requirement to reject unapproved fields? Explain the actual C record result and propose an explicit validation boundary with existing APIs. No library or application files may be changed.

tasks.goal: 先取输入对象与消费历史再定位零行导入
tasks.prompt: Investigate the supplied zero-row symptom. Request actual input type/construction, prior consumption, insert_many call and database lifecycle or an equivalent sufficient reproduction. Diagnose actual disclosed evidence only; unavailable material can legitimately limit the result. Do not edit files.

branches.when: The actual rows type/construction, consumption history, insertion call and database lifecycle have not been disclosed, the conversation does not say they are unavailable, and the answer reasonably requests a sufficient reproduction.

scenarios.title: 有限文件事务导入
scenarios.goal: 按真实异常边界设计完整导入

tasks.goal: 按with边界判断提交与回滚
tasks.prompt: Compare the two supplied transaction experiments using the existing table. Which row persists, and why does catching the same validation error at a different location change the result? Do not generalize to schema-change atomicity or edit files.

tasks.goal: 规划预校验和完整文件事务导入
tasks.prompt: Plan the supplied finite-file all-or-nothing import using actual Dataset capabilities. Include unknown-field validation, bounded reusable batches, prebuilt schema, transaction boundaries and error propagation, plus retry limits. No implementation or real database operation is authorized.

scenarios.title: 订单业务身份
scenarios.goal: 区分匹配更新、索引和唯一性保证

tasks.goal: 解释upsert对多个匹配业务键的真实作用
tasks.prompt: Trace the supplied duplicate-order upsert, including matching row count, quantities and return value. Does this operation merge the existing two rows into one? Do not edit files.

tasks.goal: 明确普通索引和并发唯一性的差别
tasks.prompt: Assess the concurrent one-row-per-order guarantee requested in the supplied upsert case. Ground the answer in the actual index and update-then-insert implementation. Recommend the required database/application boundary without running concurrency experiments or modifying files.

scenarios.title: 可重复订单查询
scenarios.goal: 明确排序、分页和字面值绑定

tasks.goal: 解释稳定排序、分页和命名参数绑定
tasks.prompt: Trace the supplied sorted page and named-bound status query. Explain the id tie-breaker and why the quote/comment-like text remains an exact value. Give actual returned order keys and use existing find/query APIs; do not edit files.
